svg.title: CMB-only predictions compared with DESI
svg.desc: Adapted from Wen et al. Figure 2. All three original vector plots, their data and uncertainty bands are preserved. Vertical axes show percent differences from the standard model's CMB best fit; horizontal axes are logarithmic redshift.

g.text: Dashed lines: CMB-only best fits · Bands: ±2σ
0% = ΛCDM CMB best fit · No DESI data in the fits
